page_title: Angel Heart Marijuana Strain - Kind Green Buds

source_page_metadata.description: Explore the Angel Heart marijuana strain - THC levels, genetics, terpene profile, effects, flavor, and grow tips.

article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Sativa-Dominant Hybrid
Genetics: Haze × Skunk #1
Breeder: Mr. Nice Seedbank
THC Content: 18–24%
CBD Content: Low (typically under 1%)
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , Limonene , Caryophyllene
Primary Flavors: Berry, Earthy, Sweet, Diesel
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Late September to Early October
Indoor Yield: 14–18 oz per m²
Outdoor Yield: 16–20 oz per plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Some cannabis varieties express their personality quietly at first, revealing depth only after careful exploration. Angel Heart belongs to that category. Developed by Mr. Nice Seedbank, the cultivar blends classic Haze genetics with the stability and vigor of Skunk #1, creating a marijuana hybrid that emphasizes mental clarity and aromatic complexity rather than brute potency.

Instead of delivering an overwhelming punch, the experience unfolds gradually, building into a bright and expansive cerebral state. Citrus and floral notes rise from the buds while the high encourages alertness and creative thinking. For enthusiasts drawn to traditional sativa-style weed, this cultivar reflects an older breeding philosophy that prioritizes expressive terpene profiles and lively mental effects.
Genetics and Lineage

Angel Heart originates from the breeding work of Mr. Nice Seedbank, a company founded by legendary cannabis breeder Nevil Schoenmakers and later continued by Howard Marks and Shantibaba . The genetic composition combines Haze and Skunk #1, two cornerstone strains that helped shape modern cannabis breeding during the late twentieth century.

The Haze component contributes the energetic cerebral qualities associated with classic sativa varieties . Haze genetics are famous for producing tall plants with extended flowering times, airy buds, and complex terpene expressions. Aromas often include citrus, spice, and subtle floral notes, many of which appear prominently in this cultivar.

Skunk #1 adds stability and improved yield potential. As one of the earliest stabilized hybrids in cannabis history, Skunk #1 introduced dense flower formation and reliable growth patterns to many breeding projects. When paired with Haze, the result is a plant that retains the uplifting mental effects of sativa genetics while gaining a slightly more manageable structure for cultivation.
Effects and Experience

Angel Heart produces a cerebral experience that develops gradually rather than hitting all at once. After the first inhalation, many people notice a subtle mental shift characterized by heightened alertness and gentle mood elevation. The sensation can feel similar to stepping into bright sunlight after a cloudy day—clearer, sharper, and more energizing.

As the high evolves, mental stimulation becomes more pronounced. Thoughts often move fluidly, encouraging exploration of ideas and conversation. The strain’s influence on creativity has made it appealing for artistic activities such as writing, painting, or music production. Instead of overwhelming the mind, the experience tends to support focused thinking.

Physical sensations remain relatively light throughout the duration of the high. While a mild body relaxation may appear later in the experience, it rarely interferes with activity. Because of this balance between stimulation and calmness, the cultivar often suits daytime or early evening use when mental engagement is preferred over heavy sedation.
Medical Benefits

The uplifting mental qualities of Angel Heart have led some patients to explore the strain for therapeutic purposes. The stimulating cerebral effects can help counteract periods of fatigue or mental sluggishness, encouraging productivity and engagement with daily tasks. Individuals seeking cannabis that supports alertness rather than sedation often gravitate toward sativa-leaning cultivars like this one.

Emotional balance is another area where this hybrid may provide support. The gentle mood elevation associated with the high can help soften feelings of stress or discouragement. By promoting a brighter mental outlook, the plant may help individuals navigate challenging situations with greater clarity.

Certain people also turn to strains with similar profiles when addressing mild physical tension. While the cultivar is not considered heavily sedating, the light relaxation that emerges as the experience progresses can help ease everyday discomfort. Some patients incorporate medical marijuana varieties like this into daytime routines when mental clarity remains important.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The aroma of Angel Heart reflects its classic sativa lineage. Opening a container of properly cured buds releases a blend of citrus and floral haze notes accompanied by a soft earthy background. The fragrance feels bright and refreshing, with lemon zest often taking center stage.

Grinding the flowers reveals additional layers within the terpene profile . Terpinolene contributes herbal and slightly floral tones, while limonene sharpens the citrus aroma with a bright, almost sparkling quality. Myrcene adds a gentle earthiness that prevents the scent from becoming overly sharp. Together these compounds produce a complex bouquet that shifts between sweet fruit and herbal spice.

When smoked or vaporized, the flavor often mirrors the aroma closely. The inhale tends to deliver citrus and light tropical sweetness, while the exhale reveals subtle haze-like spice and herbal undertones. The smoke generally feels smooth, leaving a lingering lemony aftertaste that remains noticeable for several minutes.
Growing Information

Cultivating Angel Heart requires some patience, particularly for growers unfamiliar with strong sativa genetics. Plants tend to stretch considerably during the transition to flowering, producing tall branches that benefit from training methods such as topping or low-stress training. Managing canopy height helps ensure even light distribution throughout the plant.

Indoor flowering usually requires between ten and twelve weeks. Buds often develop elongated structures typical of Haze varieties, forming clusters coated in sticky trichomes rather than dense compact nuggets. During the final weeks of flowering, the citrus aroma becomes especially pronounced, filling the cultivation space with bright lemon and floral haze notes.

For growers looking to grow marijuana , maintaining steady environmental conditions will help the plant reach its full potential. Moderate humidity levels protect the airy flowers from mold while consistent feeding supports healthy development. When cultivated carefully, the plant produces fragrant buds that capture the vibrant terpene profile associated with classic Haze hybrids.
FAQ

What strain is Angel Heart? Angel Heart is a sativa-dominant hybrid bred by Mr. Nice Seedbank. It combines Haze and Skunk #1 genetics to produce a cultivar with uplifting mental effects and citrus-forward aromas.
How strong is Angel Heart? THC levels typically range from about 17% to 22%. While potency can vary depending on cultivation conditions, the strain is generally considered moderately strong.

What does Angel Heart taste like? The flavor profile often features lemon zest, herbal haze spice, and subtle tropical sweetness. Many people notice citrus notes on the inhale followed by a slightly spicy finish.
Is Angel Heart good for daytime use? Yes. The energetic cerebral effects often make it suitable for daytime activities such as creative work, social interaction, or outdoor exploration.

How long does the high from Angel Heart last? The experience typically lasts between two and three hours. It begins with mental stimulation and gradually transitions into mild relaxation as the effects taper off.
Final Thoughts on Angel Heart

Angel Heart reflects the influence of two of the most important strains in cannabis history: Haze and Skunk #1. By combining these legendary genetics, breeders created a cultivar that emphasizes cerebral stimulation, aromatic complexity, and classic sativa character. The result is a marijuana hybrid that feels both energetic and refined.

One of the most appealing aspects of this plant lies in the clarity of its effects. Instead of producing overwhelming sedation, the high encourages mental exploration and creativity. For many cannabis enthusiasts, this type of weed provides an ideal balance between stimulation and composure.

The strain also carries historical significance within the broader cannabis breeding landscape. Haze and Skunk genetics have influenced countless modern hybrids, and Angel Heart serves as a reminder of the foundational work that shaped today’s marijuana varieties .

For growers and consumers alike, the cultivar offers a distinctive combination of bright citrus aroma, uplifting mental effects, and classic cannabis heritage. Those seeking a traditional sativa-style experience with a refined terpene profile may find that Angel Heart delivers exactly that.
